create_lfm2moe_causal_lm: create an LFM2-MoE causal language model with attention, conv, and MoE layers
build_lfm2moe_sparse_moe_block: build a sparse MoE block with sigmoid routing and expert bias for load balancing
build_lfm2moe_short_conv: build a gated short convolution layer using causal conv1d kernels with tensor parallel sharding
build_lfm2moe_attention: build grouped-query attention with RoPE and Q/K layernorm for LFM2-MoE decoder layers
run_lfm2moe_decoder_layer: run a decoder layer with attention or conv and dense MLP or MoE feed-forward network
